title: A7
nl_query: What is the tissue specificity of the EGFR protein?
stored_sample: Ubiquitously expressed. Isoform 2 is also expressed in ovarian cancers.

Ubiquitously expressed in embryos. In larvae, uniform expression is seen in wing disks, genital disk, anlagen of testis and ovary, and brain cortex. In eye-antenna disk, highest expression is anterior to morphogenetic furrow, levels remain high in photoreceptor precursor cells. This pattern is reversed in posterior eye disk. In adults expression is high in brain cortex and thoracic and abdominal ganglia.

title: C1

title: C2
nl_query: List the cancer types linked to mutations found in the DCLK3 protein.

title: C3
nl_query: Which cancer samples have under expression of AKT3 protein? Show sample name, regulation, and cancer type.
cypher: MATCH (ge:GeneExpression)-[:HASPROTEIN]->(p:Protein {hasPrimaryName: 'AKT3'}) MATCH (ge)-[:INSAMPLE]->(s:Sample)-[:IMPLICATEDIN]->(c:Cancer) WHERE ge.hasRegulation IN ['under'] RETURN DISTINCT s.hasSampleName AS SampleName, ge.hasRegulation AS Regulation, c.hasPrimaryName AS CancerType LIMIT 100

title: C4
nl_query: Which sequence motifs are hallmarks for the Human_EGFR family?
cypher: MATCH (fam:EGFRfamily {hasPrimaryName: 'Human_EGFR'})-[:ENCODEDIN]->(p:Protein)-[:HASSEQUENCE]->(seq:Sequence)-[:HASMOTIF]->(motif:SequenceMotif) RETURN DISTINCT motif.hasPrimaryName AS SequenceMotif LIMIT 100

title: C5

title: C6
